facts.value: Reads the article attachment-bone ID and the fighter stored in grab_victim. It invokes attachment cleanup, obtains the fighter joint through the copied-Yoshi bone accessor, and samples that joint into item->pos. It passes the fighter and item to it_8027B4A4 and it_8027B378, supplying zero as the latter's floating-point argument; these helpers conditionally forward fighter data to player bookkeeping when it_8026B6C8(item) succeeds, rather than removing associations. A true has_destroy_type argument writes destroy_type = 0; false leaves that field unchanged. It then clears atk_victim and grab_victim and calls it_8027CE44 and Item_8026A8EC. The stored fighter must remain usable until the preceding joint and bookkeeping calls finish.

facts.value: Tears down the fighter-attached item used by Kirby's copied-Yoshi capture handling: it invokes model-attachment cleanup, samples the fighter attachment joint into the item's position, performs conditional player bookkeeping, optionally resets destroy_type to zero, clears both stored fighter references, and invokes the final cleanup and destruction routines. The bookkeeping calls themselves do not release fighter/item associations.

facts.value: Removes the retained target item during Kirby's grounded and aerial copied-Yoshi Egg Lay completion handling. The callers require command variable 1 and a non-null target_item_gobj, pass false, then clear their target references and consume command variable 1. The same callbacks prepare a Kirby_YoshiEggLay object under a separate command-variable-0 guard; item removal does not itself create that object or guarantee creation on the same update. Adjacent fighter-victim completion paths use different routines.
